title: bidens scopulorum
intro: Bidens scopulorum, commonly known as mountain beggarticks, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Bidens scopulorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
